text:
Rina: Quick brainstorm  We want a lean PLG test: 100 credits nudge for users who sign up and complete the small 'first prompt' flow within 48h. Goal = improve 48h activation and increase prompt saves. Thoughts?

Marco: I like low cost per user. 100 feels safe. recommend gating on 'save' + 'run' events. also add a 24h nudge email if they don't finish.

Jules: UX: add a tiny floating banner in Console that says 'Complete this 2-step quickstart to get 100 credits'. Button opens quickstart modal. One-click import of a starter template.

Priya: Metrics: primary = percent with >=300 tokens in 48h. cohort tag = quickstart_100_may2026. events: marketing.quickstart_start, quickstart_complete, credits.granted. I'll wire SQL and dashboard.

Ava: Messaging variants: A: "Claim 100 credits when you ship your first prompt" B: "Finish our 2-min quickstart and get 100 credits". Run A/B with control.

Marco: Routing: include ?utm=quickstart so we can separate campaign traffic. For partner referrals, keep source=partner param.

Rina: Timeline: copy by Wed, banner by Fri, backend grant by Fri. Quick internal dogfood next Mon. Ops-bot set a reminder for Wed 10am for copy check.

ops-bot: Reminder set for Wed 10:00. Invite created: Rina, Marco, Jules, Priya, Ava.

Jules: Dev note: sample grant API call below, idempotent on request_id:
```
POST /api/v1/credits/grant { user_id, amount:100, reason:'quickstart_may2026', request_id }
```

Priya: Also proposing an eval prompt set quickstart_eval_v1 to monitor quality. will add to dashboard.

Rina: Cool. if early signals look good we'll scale to 2k users and re-evaluate CPL. Thanks team :rocket:
